description: India, Mysuru IT & Digital Technology Job Description: Senior .NET Developer Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Senior .NET Developer with strong expertise in C#, .NET Core , and enterprise backend systems. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with message queue consumer integration , scheduled/background jobs , cloud storage , and real-time databases , and will be capable of building scalable, reliable, and high-performance applications. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using C# and .NET Core / ASP.NET Core. Design, develop, and maintain backend services and microservices using .NET Core and RESTful WebAPI. Implement and manage message queue consumers for asynchronous and event-driven processing. Develop and maintain scheduled jobs / cron-based background services. Integrate and manage data storage using Azure Blob Storage for large-scale file and object storage. Model, optimize, and query data using MongoDB and InfluxDB for time-series and operational data processing. Build and consume RESTful APIs and microservices. Ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and performance optimisation. Implement robust error handling, logging, and monitoring. Collaborate with frontend, DevOps, QA, and product teams. Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and technical design. Troubleshoot and resolve production issues with a proactive approach. Containerize and deploy applications using Docker and Kubernetes. Integrate with Azure cloud services including storage, messaging, and hosting solutions. Writing unit test cases. Required Skills & Qualifications 5–7 years of hands-on experience in .NET development with strong proficiency in C# . Solid experience with .NET Core / ASP.NET Core . Strong experience with message queues (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, Kafka, MSMQ, or similar). Experience implementing background workers / cron jobs (Hangfire, Quartz.NET, Worker Services). Hands-on experience with Azure Blob Storage (upload, download, lifecycle management). Strong experience with SQL Server and database design. Knowledge of REST APIs , JSON, and API security (JWT, OAuth). Familiarity with Git and Agile/Scrum methodologies. Strong understanding of object-oriented design principles and design patterns. Experience with Azure cloud services (App Services, Functions, Storage Accounts). Experience in MongoDB & InfluxDB. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes . Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills (Secondary Skill) Experience with microservices architecture . Exposure to CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions). Experience with unit and integration testing (xUnit, NUnit, MSTest). Knowledge of application monitoring and observability tools.
